title: A transition's edge follows the pointer while you drag it
goal: User 2026-09-29: 'when I have a transition and try to resize it, the transition size doesn't follow my cursor as I drag the edge. It updates when I release the mouse only.' Likely cause from reading the code (verify first): updateClipTransitionDrag (EditorState+ClipTransitions.swift:388) writes the live length into clipTransitionDrag.landingMS, but ClipPiecesBar.band (ClipPiecesBar.swift:772) draws the band from cut.drawnTransition.lengthMS, the committed document value, which only changes in commitClipTransitionDrag. So the band, its spare-media marks and possibly the canvas preview stay put until release.
acceptance: Reproduced first: a walk at Next defaults drags a transition's edge in 20 steps with the pointer (not an accessibility press) and logs the band's drawn width and the pointer x at each step; today they disagree until release

While dragging, the band's width and position, its length label, the spare-media marks and the canvas preview at the playhead all show the live length every frame, from the drag session, and the edge stays under the pointer (within one frame of time)

While dragging either edge, a small readout bubble rides next to the pointer showing the transition's live length (e.g. 0.6s, or frames at high zoom), in the design system's drag readout style (the same one the canvas's drag readout uses), updating every frame, turning to its 'at limit' look when the spare media stops it, and fading out on release (user 2026-09-29: 'display the length of the transition while I'm adjusting it, in a tooltip or something')
Both edges, and a transition whose alignment is at one side rather than across the cut
The clamp to the longest length the spare media allows shows as the edge stopping, with the pointer moving on, never as a jump on release
Release commits one undo step exactly as now; Escape during the drag restores the old length
The same live-follow rule is checked for every other timeline drag that has a session (clip bars, trims, keys, word chips) and any that only update on release are fixed or filed

log.note: User 2026-09-29: show the live length in a readout by the pointer while dragging. Acceptance updated.
